name: pointer
description: Drive a real Chrome tab from any MCP agent, with a visible pointer the human can follow.

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('extension').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'))) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','extension/'+f])" && node --check bin/pointer.mjs && node --check bin/mcp.mjs && node --check lib/hub.mjs && node --check lib/tools.mjs
